name: view-events-status-run
description: The page pushes the first value of a status during a run, holds the values of the run, and pushes the newest value at the end of the run and a later value at once.
reason: The events of a view reach the page as notices of a window that the native host runs, and the Go producer runs no window (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
